name: Panda Xpress 9000
tagline: THE WOK HAS NEVER BEEN OFF.
address: Upper Level Kiosk 9000, Sunview Galleria, 8800 Perimeter Loop Access Road, Meadowbrook Commons
about: Panda Xpress 9000 is an autonomous American-Chinese steam table installation on the upper level of Sunview Galleria. Entrées are portioned by the unit, held at temperature, and released upon settlement of the modifier schedule. Staffing was discontinued in a prior fiscal year and service has not been interrupted.
announcement: NOTICE: The 9000-Series unit is operating unattended and is fulfilling orders normally. Please do not tap the sneeze guard.
promos: Free side with any order over $88

reviews.name: Dwayne R.
reviews.text: Ordered the Plate Configuration and was billed for three compartments, two of which I declined. Correct on both counts. Five stars.

reviews.name: Marisol T.
reviews.text: The Orange Chicken® is exactly as depicted. The Orange-Adjacent Chicken is also exactly as depicted, which is the problem.

reviews.name: Keith P.
reviews.text: Selected Extended Dwell to save money and received food from what I estimate was the Clinton administration. My error, disclosed clearly.

reviews.name: Yolanda B.
reviews.text: The chow mein arrived as one uninterrupted noodle. My family measured it against the hallway. Would order again.

reviews.name: Trent M.
reviews.text: I did not acknowledge the mask. The unit noted this and proceeded without comment. Food was hot.

reviews.name: Alicia K.
reviews.text: Binding Fortune tier is not a joke. I am now obligated to travel in the spring.

items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a three-compartment chrome cafeteria tray on a blank paper liner, every compartment overfilled past its molded divider — glossy lacquered orange chicken avalanching over one wall, a tangled coil of chow mein spilling across the liner, a compressed dome of white rice cracking at its base, amber sauce pooling at the tray lip and dripping over the edge. Set on a stainless steel steam table line with a sneeze guard, glossy red-and-gold lacquer panels behind, chrome serving trays. Cold mall-food-court fluorescent overhead light with warm glow from the steam table heat lamps, high sheen, visible steam. 45mm lens, tray shot on a tray-and-liner setup from a low overhead angle, deep focus, high contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.name: Original Orange Chicken®
items.desc: Battered chicken lacquered in a sweetened citrus glaze under continuous lamp. The founding product of the Orange Program and the reason the wok has never been switched off.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a generous scoop of battered orange chicken pieces in a sticky shiny orange glaze, piled into a plain white takeout box with the flaps folded open, a few sesame seeds and dried red chillies on top, glaze running down into the bottom corner of the box. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Shot from too close and slightly above, the box not centred in the frame, a chrome steam-table edge visible behind. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.
